title: Stalkwise etale sections preserve epimorphisms at a strictly henselian point
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale a functor [def-sc-zariski-site] [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] whose underlying scheme functor equals X.restrictFunctor. Let x be a point whose local ring O_X,x is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Define E on abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] by E(G)=colim over Zariski neighbourhoods U of x of G(i(U)), using the canonical restriction maps. Then E preserves epimorphisms. No assumption is made on local rings at other points and no cohomology or injective resolution occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 03Q6, degree zero (local-ring continuity on affine neighbourhoods); Tag 03QO, proof (sections at the closed point); Tag 09AX, proof, local-ring step. Read from the local Stacks source mirror and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QO.

proof.text: Use the degree-zero continuity comparison to factor E as an epimorphism-preserving inverse-image functor H followed by terminal sections on Spec(O_X,x). Install hx as the strictly henselian local-ring instance. Apply the source library theorem Scheme.surjective_app_of_epi_of_isStrictlyHenselianLocalRing to each epimorphism of abelian sheaves, and convert its surjectivity into epimorphism using AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective. Compose the preservation instances and transport across the comparison isomorphism by Functor.PreservesEpimorphisms.of_iso.

WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.StrictlyHenselian proves terminal-section surjectivity, requiring a degree-zero continuity comparison here; its default coefficient universe and the existing derived-cohomology module differ from the present one. lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselian_stalkSections_preservesEpimorphisms
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (x : X) (hx : IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (etaleObjectStalkSections X i x).PreservesEpimorphisms
